coordinate_convention: right-handed world XYZ; t=s cross d; target d is arriving direction
description: M7A-REF-001: 1550 nm public-width SMF–AF45 Glass Waveguide concept proxy. Both external Gaussian fields and the fixed layout are explicit assumptions. Actual applicability and Total Coupling are Uncomputed.

wavelength_m.source: Shared 1550 nm reporting wavelength in Corning PI1424 and Eaton et al. Fig. 5(c)

position_m.source: Concept geometry from the fixed M5-A position/frame control; independent of either published device

propagation_direction.source: Concept geometry from the fixed M5-A position/frame control; independent of either published device

sagittal_axis.source: Concept geometry from the fixed M5-A position/frame control; independent of either published device

reference_plane.source: Concept air-side plane adjacent to an ideal normal facet; Concept geometry from the fixed M5-A position/frame control; independent of either published device

mfd_ts_m.source: 1/e² circular external Gaussian proxy using the width scale from Corning SMF-28 Ultra PI1424, Optical Specifications, 1550 nm MFD 10.4 ± 0.5 µm

wavefront_curvature_ts_per_m.source: Concept-only flat wavefront at the external reference plane; phase not supplied by the cited width source

polarization.source: Current scalar Gaussian model; no polarization transport

mode_evidence.source: Published size scale only; external complex field and Gaussian fit unverified
